notes.title: Pre update
notes.content: Pre update some content such as new weapon and range map

notes.title: Repair and optimization
notes.content:
The changes are as follows
1. Added support for mouse reversal
2. Fixed difficulty unlocking levels correctly
3. There will be a location prompt in the current campaign mode
4. Optimized the setting of physical strength value

notes.title: The game has now been released as a preemptive experience version
notes.content: Now, all players can purchase and experience the game

notes.title: Large content updates
notes.content:
The changes in this round of updates are as follows
-Added support for 7 languages, namely French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, German, Japanese, and Korean. If you want to switch from native Chinese to these languages, you need to set them in the lower right corner of the main menu
-Added all 4 tasks for the first map farm in the suburbs of the first section of the campaign mode
-Added and optimized some support systems
-Fixed a bug where the archive may suddenly be lost
-Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: Update and optimization
notes.content:
-Fixed some bugs
-Pre updated some campaign modes (disaster area mode)
-Provided support for some controllers
-English localization is now available

notes.title: Delay of issuance time
notes.content: Sorry, because we has a more important projects to complete first, so all development plans of this project will be delayed. Thank you for your understanding !

notes.title: About localization of Demo version
notes.content: Due to the problem of the engine, the new version cannot be localized temporarily. We are working to solve this problem. So the current Demo may have many missing contents

notes.title: Please go to the branch version for testing
notes.content:
If you need to experience the game, please go to the store to apply for a beta test. In order to unify the players of the version, the update of this version has been suspended

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2257170

notes.title: The public test of Online mode has started now!
notes.content: The public test of online mode has started, and now you are invited to participate in the test for free! You can post any feedback or suggestions to the Steam community for public discussion, so that developers can know what you want, or you can send them to the email dgt12322@outlook.com Discuss with developers directly!
